purpose: Check native Job and root-process handle lifetimes through production owner-loop transitions, with a mutation control.
behavior: Relaunches the exact test in separate processes for forced stop, natural exit, live descendants, unknown member proof and a mutation that retains the original Job handle.
Uses GetHandleInformation on the original numeric handles, without cloning, to require Job closure before Stopped/Release while the exited root handle remains valid and signalled.
Asserts a live descendant keeps its Job open, repeated Stop remains idempotent, List becomes empty after gone, and Release finally closes the root PID pin.
The mutation subprocess must fail specifically at the Job-closure oracle.
contracts: Process isolation prevents parallel tests from reusing a closed numeric handle and invalidating the negative oracle.
dependencies: Tree::raw_handles/retain_job_on_gone test hooks; tests/mod.rs Looped; native Windows handle/process queries.
failures_or_limits: The unknown-proof case deliberately accepts the one-second fallback with a diagnostic. This is a test specification plus mutation design, not an executed result.

purpose: Specify member inventory filtering and completion-port departure proof outside the owner loop.
behavior: Assigns one paused process to a Job and leaves an outsider alive; inventory must retain only the live member, omit an exited PID, then become empty after member termination.
Requires NEW_PROCESS notification to record a member without polling, injects an outsider PID as a reuse stand-in and observes the flush-marker Pending phase.
Checks a live member blocks proof, then termination and wait allow Gone while the outsider stays alive.
contracts: An outsider PID is a deterministic model of reuse; no actual numeric PID recycling is forced.
dependencies: inventory::of and Members::prove; job::create/terminate; Looped test utilities create cmd.exe pause children.
failures_or_limits: The test deliberately calls prove while the Job is live to exercise Pending, unlike the production empty-Job precondition. It does not validate the owner fallback deadline or full pipe protocol and was not run.

purpose: Exercise owner-loop edge states that end-to-end Windows tests cannot reliably force.
behavior: Drives Supervisor directly with encoded reply capture and actual contained cmd.exe children, retaining host pipe ends until a case releases them.
Fills 1024 reply slots with an empty Inbox, then requires writer progress to wake request admission.
Blinds a member probe or suppresses a NEW_PROCESS notification and requires Stopped between 900 ms and two seconds plus the corresponding diagnostic.
Fills or breaks stderr while checking another tree stop remains timely, and lowers the tree cap to require an I/O failure plus EOF on the refused transferred stdout.
contracts: The fixture owner loop uses production step/enforce paths and native children, but bypasses the named-pipe transport.
dependencies: Supervisor, Members test hooks, Inbox/Outbox, Diag and job_lifetime/members subtests.
failures_or_limits: Timing windows are assertions for a future Windows run; no performance or passing status is established here. Thread/liveness setup is bounded by ten-second helpers.

purpose: Manage one Windows tree from root/Job ownership through shared stopping, settlement and Release.
behavior: Pins the root PID with its process handle; concurrent Stops accumulate waiters and keep the earliest deadline, with grace zero forcing immediately.
Graceful pipe stop sends CTRL_BREAK to the pinned root group; terminal stop or root exit closes ConPTY asynchronously. At deadline and each unsettled forced poll, Job termination is attempted.
Gone requires root exit and a confirmed zero active count, then either full member proof or one second of unresolved proof with a diagnostic; it closes the owned Job before returning Stop waiters.
Gone List is empty; PTY resize requires a live terminal; the process pin survives until the released tree record is dropped.
contracts: Root exit is distinct from tree-gone; unknown Job count does not complete normal settlement.
dependencies: job.rs kill/count; members.rs proof; inventory.rs List; pty_windows.rs nonblocking close; mod.rs sends replies and drops released records.
failures_or_limits: Stopped can follow an unproven Pending/Unknown member result after the bound, so it is not always a per-process signalled-handle proof. exit_code ignores GetExitCodeProcess failure and then returns its initialized zero value.
